environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. The Flask application handles all HTTP parsing directly. Database file is local on the instance EBS volume.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP mode, port 443 passthrough
